nodes.description: ZethrInterface instance pointing at external Zethr contract 0xD48B...020D, used for balanceOf and buyAndTransfer.
Address receiving withdrawn contract balance and updatable by owner.
Owner address initialized to msg.sender at deployment, gate for privileged functions.
Payable function that reads balances before/after an external buyAndTransfer call and emits onTokenPurchase.
Payable fallback function accepting plain ether transfers into the proxy.
Owner-only function that reassigns the bankroll address variable.
Owner-only function that transfers the whole contract balance to bankroll.
Caller-controlled address used as token holder, buy target, owner comparison and ether sender.
External payable call zethr.buyAndTransfer.value(msg.value)(_referredBy, msg.sender, "", divChoice) executed before the post-balance read.
bankroll.transfer(address(this).balance) sends full contract balance to an owner-settable address.
Unchecked subtraction balanceAfter - balanceBefore used for the emitted tokensMinted amount (Solidity 0.4.24, no SafeMath).
Referrer address parameter of buyTokensWithProperEvent, forwarded to the external buy call.
uint8 dividend-rate selector parameter of buyTokensWithProperEvent, forwarded to buyAndTransfer.
New bankroll address parameter of changeBankroll, written into the bankroll state variable.
Local holding zethr.balanceOf(msg.sender) before the external buy.
Local holding zethr.balanceOf(msg.sender) after the external buy.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the caller funding and invoking buyTokensWithProperEvent with arbitrary value.
Any msg.sender can send ether directly to the payable fallback function.
changeBankroll is gated by require(msg.sender == owner); authorization depends on caller identity.
sendDivsToBankroll is gated by require(msg.sender == owner); authorization depends on caller identity.
msg.sender is forwarded as the token target of the external buyAndTransfer call.
owner state variable is compared against msg.sender in the changeBankroll guard.
owner state variable is compared against msg.sender in the sendDivsToBankroll guard.
buyTokensWithProperEvent forwards msg.value, _referredBy, msg.sender and divChoice into the external buyAndTransfer call.
External payable call to an untrusted contract executes before the post-balance read, allowing re-entry into the payable fallback/buy flow.
zethr state variable provides the external contract target whose buyAndTransfer is invoked.
balanceBefore is initialized from zethr.balanceOf(msg.sender).
balanceAfter is read from the same zethr contract after the external buy call mutated the caller's token balance.
balanceBefore is an operand of the unchecked subtraction that determines tokensMinted.
balanceAfter is an operand of the unchecked subtraction that determines tokensMinted.
bankroll state variable is the storage slot written by changeBankroll.
bankroll is the recipient address of the transfer of the contract balance.
sendDivsToBankroll performs bankroll.transfer(address(this).balance) on the whole contract balance.
_referredBy parameter is consumed inside buyTokensWithProperEvent and passed to the external call.
divChoice parameter is consumed inside buyTokensWithProperEvent and passed to the external call.
_newBankroll parameter is written into the bankroll state variable inside changeBankroll.

normalization_plan.reason: Input parameter only exists to be forwarded to the external buy call inside buyTokensWithProperEvent; its semantics are captured by the enclosing function node.
uint8 rate selector parameter is used solely in the external buyAndTransfer invocation and adds no distinct security-relevant state.
Parameter is a transient value assigned to the bankroll state variable within the owner-gated changeBankroll function.
Ephemeral local read from zethr.balanceOf used only as the subtrahend of the unchecked balance subtraction.
Ephemeral local read after the external call used only as the minuend of the unchecked balance subtraction.
